text: こっちは　そんなヒマ　ないんでね　じゃな！

structure.jp: こっちは　そんなヒマ　ないんでね
structure.en: me, I don't have that kind of free time, you see

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: んで is the casual form of ので, 'because'; here the sentence stops there, leaving the rest unsaid. ないんでね = 'since I don't have any, you see'.
